title: Single-Key Indifferentiability of Generic AEAD Compositions
summary: All generic AEAD compositions of Namprempre et al.

formal_statement.body: For the generic AEAD compositions of Namprempre et al., Barbosa and Farshim established non-indifferentiability for every composition in the two-key setting and for only some compositions, including SIV, in the single-key setting. For each composition not covered by their single-key result, determine whether it is indifferentiable in the single-key setting or construct a single-key differentiator.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptography, specifically indifferentiability of the generic AEAD compositions of Namprempre et al.
parameters: Composition: any generic AEAD composition of Namprempre et al. not covered by the existing single-key result
scope.unresolved_remainder: For every uncovered composition, either prove single-key indifferentiability or construct a single-key differentiator.

citations.label: A Modular Approach to the Incompressibility of Block-Cipher-Based AEADs

progress.summary: The source attributes two-key non-indifferentiability for all these compositions and single-key non-indifferentiability for some, including SIV, to Barbosa and Farshim. It leaves the remaining single-key cases without either an indifferentiability result or a differentiator.
citation_labels: Akinori Hosoyamada et al., A Modular Approach to the Incompressibility of Block-Cipher-Based AEADs
